source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Critical Region' under topic 7.3 (PDF 96, printed 92).

blocks.text: Critical region qeematon ki ek had (range) hai. Agar test statistic is region mein aa jaye to null hypothesis reject ho jata hai. Yeh testing se pehle tay ki jati hai aur significance level par depend karti hai. Yeh intehai (extreme) nataij dikhati hai. Critical regions faisla karne mein madad deti aur ghair-yaqeeni (uncertainty) kam karti hain. Graphs aksar critical region dikhate hain. Is concept ko samajhna zaroori hai.
